about.bio: I work from silicon to software - writing ESP32-S3 firmware for BLE and Wi-Fi, authenticating drones with PUFs, and taking Android apps apart with Frida. From reconnaissance to privilege escalation, I care about how the whole stack holds up.

work.title: Cyber Security Intern
work.desc: Android forensics and Linux and Windows exploitation, with every attack chain documented end to end.

work.title: Organiser & Coordinator
work.desc: Running national-level and university events at DCRUST, plus a year as a Senior Under Officer in the NCC.

projects.name: PUF Drone Authentication
projects.tag: A drone that proves who it is from its silicon.
projects.desc: A drone that proves who it is from its silicon.
projects.long: A UAV authentication system built on Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs), so each drone is identified from its silicon rather than from a stored credential. Keys are derived on demand from the PUF response, which means no secret key is kept on the device - nothing at rest to extract or clone.

projects.name: Mayavi
projects.tag: One ESP32-S3 that is a keyboard, mouse, gamepad and media remote.
projects.desc: One ESP32-S3 that is a keyboard, mouse, gamepad and media remote.
projects.long: ESP32-S3 firmware that acts as a Bluetooth LE HID device - keyboard, mouse, gamepad and media remote - with 11 selectable profiles, plus a Wi-Fi access point with a browser dashboard and a serial console. A non-blocking payload runner sits on NVS-backed settings and a LittleFS-hosted JSON API. Authorized-use limits and security trade-offs, such as the open access point default and Just Works pairing, are documented.

projects.name: Drax
projects.tag: A mobile app security scanner that survives RASP.
projects.desc: A mobile app security scanner that survives RASP.
projects.long: A Python scanner with an Android agent over ADB, built to keep working inside RASP-protected apps. About 50 static, dynamic and Frida-based checks. For authorised assessments only.

projects.name: Labs
projects.tag: Disposable labs for security training and CTF practice.
projects.desc: Disposable labs for security training and CTF practice.
projects.long: Disposable offensive security labs for training and CTF practice, including a file upload lab with 6 filter-bypass challenges.

projects.name: Quarters
projects.tag: A self-hostable pixel-art HQ for your whole team.
projects.desc: A self-hostable pixel-art HQ for your whole team.
projects.long: A pixel-art virtual HQ with proximity voice and video and Discord-style spaces. One deploy serves a whole team.

projects.name: SaviOS Desktop
projects.tag: An Arch desktop rebuilt from one script.
projects.desc: An Arch desktop rebuilt from one script.
projects.long: A reproducible Arch Linux desktop - CachyOS kernel, Hyprland and Quickshell - rebuilt from scratch by one idempotent install script.

projects.name: Ryoku
projects.tag: Open-source fix: battery reporting on multi-battery systems.
projects.desc: Open-source fix: battery reporting on multi-battery systems.
projects.long: Open-source contribution (Nov 2026): fixed incorrect battery reporting on multi-battery systems so readouts show total charge, not just the first pack.

projects.name: ShadowGate
projects.tag: HTTP/S command & control with encrypted beaconing.
projects.desc: HTTP/S command & control with encrypted beaconing.
projects.long: HTTP/S command & control framework with AES-GCM encrypted beaconing, modular plugin architecture, and dynamic payload generation. Supports multi-client management, task queuing, encrypted exfiltration, and jitter-based beacon timing for OpSec.

projects.name: PhantomRecon
projects.tag: An automated recon pipeline with pluggable scanners.
projects.desc: An automated recon pipeline with pluggable scanners.
projects.long: Automated reconnaissance toolkit: subdomain enumeration via passive sources, port scanning with service fingerprinting, technology stack detection, and screenshot capture. Pipeline architecture with modular scanner plugins and structured JSON output.

projects.name: Wazuh Sentinel
projects.tag: 40+ custom Wazuh rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
projects.desc: 40+ custom Wazuh rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
projects.long: Custom SIEM detection engine: 40+ custom Wazuh rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK covering T1055 (Process Injection), T1078 (Valid Accounts), T1003 (Credential Dumping), and T1482 (Domain Trust Discovery). Automated alert triage pipeline with Slack notification routing.

projects.name: BinaryForge
projects.tag: A binary exploitation framework for x86/x64 Linux.
projects.desc: A binary exploitation framework for x86/x64 Linux.
projects.long: Binary exploitation framework: ROP chain builder, buffer overflow exploit generator, and format string vulnerability testing harness. Supports x86/x64 Linux targets with PIE/ASLR/NX bypass techniques and position-independent shellcode execution.

projects.name: PacketSentry
projects.tag: A network intrusion detection system on raw sockets and BPF.
projects.desc: A network intrusion detection system on raw sockets and BPF.
projects.long: Network intrusion detection system using raw sockets and BPF for real-time packet capture and analysis. Detects port scans, ARP spoofing, DNS tunneling, and SYN floods with custom signature-based alerting and PCAP export.

projects.name: ForgeProxy
projects.tag: An HTTP/HTTPS intercept proxy for web app testing.
projects.desc: An HTTP/HTTPS intercept proxy for web app testing.
projects.long: HTTP/HTTPS intercept proxy for web application testing. Request/response inspection, modification, and replay with built-in CA certificate generation for TLS interception. WebSocket support and automated fuzzing integration.

projects.name: CryptoBreach
projects.tag: Classic crypto attacks, implemented to learn from them.
projects.desc: Classic crypto attacks, implemented to learn from them.
projects.long: Cryptographic attack toolkit: implementations of Bleichenbacher's padding oracle attack, RSA timing side-channel, hash length extension, and format-preserving oracle attacks. Educational tool for understanding real-world crypto vulnerabilities.
